game.name: ROBLOX: Speed Run 4
game.rules:
**General Rules**
---

- All Runs need to be performed on the [version](https://www.roblox.com/games/183364845/Speed-Run-4) linked in the "Resources" tab. 
- Using game passes that affect the gameplay (Coils, Level Skip, Cloud) is not allowed unless stated otherwise in the category rules.

**Recording a run**
---

- Video proof is required for **all runs**. The video must start before the player gets speed on the first level and end after the player gets teleported to the next level at the end of the run.
- It is recommended to reset the in-game timer by using the "level select" feature before starting a new run.
- Things that should be visible throughout the entire run are:
- The money counter
- The in-game timer
- The player list as well as the scoreboard timer are generally not required for verification but might be used as additional proof in some cases.

**Timing and submitting a run**
---

- For *full-game runs*, RTA is used. Timing starts on the frame before the in-game timer has any time on it in level 1 and ends as soon as the in-game timer gets reset after the last level of the run. Please do **not** submit IGT for full-game runs.
- For *IL runs*, IGT is used. The time that is visible in the last frame before the in-game timer gets reset will be used as the final time. Exceptions to this will be made if the timer gets paused at the end due to a video lag. Please submit your IL times as both Real Time **and** IGT.
- If the in-game timer cannot be used for retiming, timing instead starts on the frame before the player gets speed and ends when the player touches the portal.
- Please submit all runs, especially ILs, as individually cut out videos.

categories.name: No Skips
categories.rules:
* Using skips is not allowed. This includes:
  * Jumping/Bouncing on the death plane
  * Using platforms that just exist for decoration to skip part of a level
  * Using platforms that do not exist in the default dimension to skip part of a level
